title: Eikthyr

infobox.Drops: Eikthyr trophy, Hard antler x3, Eikthyr Power

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Eikthyr is the first boss. He appears as an abnormally large stag with iron chains wrapped around his electrified red antlers.

sections.heading: Summoning
sections.text:
Eikthyr's Forsaken Altar is located in the Meadows. To the left of his Sacrificial Stone is a small glowing Runestone called a Vegvisir; interacting with it will add his closest summoning location on the map.
He is summoned by placing two Deer trophy in his Forsaken altar in the Meadows. Like all bosses, Eikthyr can be summoned as many times as desired, provided the required materials are met.

sections.heading: Attacks and abilities
sections.text: Eikthyr has three types of attacks in addition to an environmental aura that forces darkness and removes raining.

sections.heading: Antler
sections.text: A swiping melee attack with his antlers (20 Pierce, 1000 Tier 0 Chop and 1000 Tier 0 Pickaxe damage). This attack features a 5-second cooldown and can be used when a player is within 4 meters. It has a range of 4.5 meters and hits in a horizontal arc spanning 25 degrees.

sections.heading: Charge
sections.text: A ranged beam attack that fans out horizontally 45 degrees and extends 20 meters out (15 Lightning damage). On contact, the beam will inflict the Lightning status. This has a 25-second cooldown and Eikthyr can attempt to use this ability when a player is within 15 meters.

sections.heading: Stomp
sections.text: A 10-meter radius area-of-effect attack that expands outward from the center and inflicts the Lightning status (15 Lightning damage). This attack has a 40-second cooldown. He can use this ability when a player is within 6 meters.

sections.heading: Aftermath
sections.text: Defeating Eikthyr allows the player to craft the first pickaxe to begin mining ore to create metal tools, weapons, and armor.

sections.heading: Forsaken power
sections.text:
Mounting Eikthyr’s trophy upon his respective stone will allow the player to claim his Forsaken Power. This ability will grant the player and nearby allies the following effects for 300 seconds:
• Run stamina usage: -60%
• Jump stamina usage: -60%
• Swim stamina usage: -60%

sections.heading: Events
sections.text:
Defeating Eikthyr affects the following events for that world:
• Disables: "Eikthyr rallies the creatures of the forest."
• Enables: "The forest is moving..." (if The Elder hasn't been defeated)

sections.heading: Creature spawning
sections.text: Defeating Eikthyr unlocks Greydwarfs to spawn in the Meadows at night. They can only have 0 stars.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Eikthyr is likely a reference to Eikþyrnir, a stag which stands upon Valhalla in Norse mythology.
• When Eikthyr's trophy is mounted on an item mount, he will sometimes say, "So you were my death? You look so small and soft... Tell Odin he may have broken this form but the wilderness will never submit to his rules..."
• Eikthyr is sometimes known as "deer" in the game files.
• In the in-game trophies menu, there is another description of Eikthyr, "Once the king of the forest, the size of the antlers are truly impressive."
• Eikthyr is susceptible to spirit damage, but there are no early game weapons with spirit damage to make use of this weakness. By the time that weapons with spirit damage are available, the player should not have any difficulty fighting Eikthyr anyway.
• There is reference to a "Horned One" on one of the Runestones that can be found in the Meadows, which can be assumed to be Eikthyr:
